Second question: for ℓ ≥ 2, is limsup Q₂(⋯)/n² infinite? The statement says, for every ℓ ≥ 2 and every C, frequently C·n² < Q₂(⋯). The positive answer (van Doorn / Aletheia Pell construction) is recorded on the page, matching the 'solved' tag. Faithful.
